description: We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations and ensuring the highest quality of patient care. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate and skilled leader committed to fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.This full-time position offers an annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses, bringing a strong clinical background to this essential leadership role. Join a team dedicated to excellence in patient care and professional growth.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with some leadership or supervisory experience
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of clinical best practices and regulatory compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Boonsboro, MD, as an MDS Coordinator (RN). This vital role involves ensuring accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, which are crucial for resident care planning and facility reimbursement. We are seeking a detail-oriented and compassionate Registered Nurse to contribute to our commitment to exceptional patient outcomes.As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a key role in the interdisciplinary team, collaborating with various departments to gather comprehensive resident information. Your expertise will directly impact the quality of care provided and the financial health of the facility. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN with a passion for clinical documentation and regulatory compliance to make a significant impact.We offer a competitive hourly rate of $43.00 - $46.00, reflecting your valuable skills and experience. If you are ready to advance your career in a supportive and dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility.
Comprehensive understanding of the RAI process, Medicare, and Medicaid regulations.
Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) and MDS software.
Strong organizational, communication, and assessment skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $43.00 - $46.00, based on experience.
